text:
For your 40-minute train commute, I recommend podcasts that blend literary analysis with engaging storytelling to match your interest in both classic and contemporary fiction. "The Book Review" from The New York Times offers excellent author interviews and deep dives into current literary trends. "99% Invisible" might be too off-topic, but "The Literary Life" or "Bookworm" provide intimate conversations with authors and discussions on book club favorites. Additionally, "Hardcore History" is too long, so stick to shorter formats like "The New Yorker: Fiction" which features readings and discussions of short stories, keeping the content digestible within your commute window.

The meal that comes second in the day, after breakfast, is lunch.
